reviewer: Codex: source, first-use lesson, native workbook and localized review-note inspection
review_scope: Prepared fictional month-end comparison only. Current CLI runs and source/value replay are verified. Worksheet headers and selected rows were visually inspected in all seven sheets of both unique workbooks; the five locale editions are byte-identical per phase. No learner, live voice, tax or professional approval is attested.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: The plain title introduces a normal month-end bank reconciliation: supply the bank statement and bank ledger, name the account and period, review the proposed interpretation and use the resulting workpapers. The lesson explains the complete first-use task without turning an allocation feature into the subject.
editorial.inputs_and_request: Read the localized case note and all five outlines. The current bounded native inspection identifies the two March exports, ISO dates, negative outgoing amounts and distinct transaction references. The natural request is usable without naming a script or schema. The same one-account fictional scope is explicit in every language.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: The owning current inspection and reconciliation commands read the managed sources and create their normal workbook, detailed files and review notes. The two checkpoints identify the source roles and trace a matched payment. Exact individual matching is an explicit synthetic test review, not a stored learner approval. The real case ledger completes with its declared output files.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: The workbook makes the bank and journal dates, amounts, zero difference and shared reference readable. Header shading, fitted widths, wrapped text and frozen identifiers preserve the actual tables. All seven worksheet views were inspected for both unique phase files; no reviewed field is clipped. Localized review notes state counts and tell the reader to check scope, trace a match and investigate any unmatched items. Canonical worksheet/field names and the reference stage identifier remain English technical labels.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: The cumulative April files add the 4 April payment of EUR 488 with TRN-003 on physical source row 4 in both exports. A fresh run matches three rather than two payments and preserves the March files. The exercise asks how to investigate a bank movement absent from the ledger; the closing instruction tells the learner what to supply for another real account and period.
editorial.language_and_pacing: Read the it lesson and case note and the actual demo/practice review notes. The explanations follow the chosen language, with the same scope and task in all editions. Six stages total 390 seconds. Detailed exploration, questions and processing may take longer; no measured learner duration or native voice behavior is claimed.
